GDD §7 BOSS — 1.4.0 changes (draft by P1; P10 folds this into docs/GDD.md §7)
================================================================================

Replace the table-HP sentence with:
Every level ends with a boss. Table HP = 24·E_boss(L), ×1.25 on finales (every 5th level: data.isFinale(L) = L % 5 === 0 is
the only finale test), rounded to 50; Colossus Prime's ×1.25 never stacks with the finale's. At spawn: table × count scale
× shop scale. In the campaign the count scale never goes below the table (BOSSES.squadScale.minMult 1.0) and the shop scale
is the full clamp(m^0.9, 1, 10) at any squad size (BOSSES.shopScale.fade false; endless mini-bosses keep the 1.3.0 fade).

New paragraph — the under-curve floor (r8v2, BOSSES.ttkBand.under, level._bossUnderFloor):
A campaign squad that reaches the boss below the target (C < E_boss) meets at least t·mult·(E_boss/C)^3 seconds of fight
against its own fire: HP ≥ round50(DPS(E)·t·mult·(E/C)^2), DPS(E) = E·fire rate·damage·boss damage·0.8, mult = the table's
finale / Prime multiple, C/E floored at 0.3. t = 11.5 s from L6 to L60, rising 0.005 s per level to 12.5 s at L260
(under.tAt can override single levels: the L5 experiment). A squad at 0.9·E kills a regular boss in ≈ 15.8 s of fire, at 0.8·E
in 22.5 s, at 0.7·E in 33.5 s, at 0.6·E in 53 s — past the enrage. effStatic (1.0) multiplies the floor, decided at the boss's
spawn, only for a run that did not play its gates (fewer counted gate decisions than the assist rule of §10) and for the
generator's never-steering model lines; it stays 1.0 because the P1 boss audit fixed the static squads' extra damage at its
source (below).

New paragraph — ENRAGE (replaces the 45 s safety valve in the campaign; BOSSES.valve.campaign):
20 s after the fight starts (26 s on a finale) the boss walks to 3 m and chews round(chew·(1 + n)) soldiers in second n,
chew = max(3, round(0.05·E_boss)); the squad keeps firing. Slow archetypes enrage later for a squad arriving near full size:
Colossus and Colossus Prime +6 s, Hulk Twins +8 s, in full from 0.95·E_boss and none below 0.8·E_boss (an under-curve squad
keeps the plain 20 / 26 s). boss.js emits 'boss:enrage' { after, extra } when it starts (after = seconds from boss:fight,
extra = the archetype's part), and 'boss:fight' carries enrageAt (the same seconds) for the HUD countdown. Measured: L12
(Hulk) squad pinned at 0.6·E_boss at the fight — boss:enrage 19.98 s after boss:fight, L15 (finale) 26 s (smoke,
build/P1/smoke/fr1/enrage-L12, enrage-L15; fix round 2: build/P1/smoke/fr2/enrage-L12). Endless mini-bosses keep the 45 s
valve (3 soldiers/s).
FIELD GUIDE (fix round 2): the TOO SLOW entry (boss.valve, 'bosses' section, marked seen at the first chew) now reads
BOSSES.valve.campaign and the endless valve: "After 20 s of fight (26 s on a finale; slow bosses may wait a bit longer) the
boss walks in and eats more soldiers every second. Endless: 45 s, 3 a second." 1.3.0's line ("After 45 s of fight … eats 3
soldiers a second") described only the endless valve once the campaign enrage shipped. No doc lists the entry texts (§14's
Field guide row describes the screen); the numbers stay read from data.js and check-codex checks the entry.
Tables (fix round 2): in the §7 beat table replace the 'Safety valve | fight > 45 s' row with two rows —
  | Enrage (campaign) | fight > 20 s (26 s on a finale; Colossus / Prime +6 s, Twins +8 s for a squad ≥ 0.8·E_boss, in full
  at 0.95·E_boss) | Boss advances to 3 m and chews round(chew·(1 + n)) soldiers in second n, chew = max(3, round(0.05·E_boss)),
  while being shot point blank; each chew: floater, red vignette pulse. The run is lost only when C = 0 | — |
  | Safety valve (endless mini-bosses) | fight > 45 s | as 1.3.0: 3 soldiers/s | — |
and in §0's Boss row replace "safety valve chews 3 soldiers/s" with "the campaign boss enrages after 20 s (26 s on a finale)
and chews a growing share of the squad; endless mini-bosses keep the 45 s valve (3 soldiers/s)". ARCHITECTURE §6 (boss.js):
the "Safety valve: after valve.after 45 s" sentence gains "; a campaign boss uses spec.valveAfter / chew / chewRamp
(level._fireBoss from BOSSES.valve.campaign) and emits boss:enrage".

Campaign attacks: the Hulk slam kills 5 % of C (min 3) + L/2; the Spitter Queen's globs 2 % of C each (campaign only).

Sniper vs bosses (the P1 boss audit, D18; amend §8.3's sniper row): a boss shot is capped at 5 % (before the boss-damage
upgrade) of boss.capHp, set at the spawn = the boss HP before the floors (table × count scale × shop scale) for a squad at or
above E_boss, and the HP at exactly E_boss × C/E_boss under the curve — the sniper's boss damage never grows with the floors.
At C ≥ E_boss this is 1.3.0's cap whenever the TTK floor does not bind; where it binds (big squads past ≈ 1.3·E_boss, finale
bosses) the cap stays at the unfloored HP, a deliberate change from 1.3.0 (the floor sets the shortest fight; a cap riding on
it shortened that fight again). Before, the cap was 5 % of the boss's floor-raised max
HP, so an under-curve squad that drove through a sniper lane took 12.5 % of any boss per free shot at rank 10 and beat the
under-curve floor (live boss DPS up to 7× the squad formula; every other source ≤ 1.14×). Endless mini-bosses keep the max-HP
cap. Audit report: build/P1/audit.txt.

Rotation (data.bossIdOf): L1–L30 from BOSSES.rotation with the Hulk Twins debut moved to L16 (L17 the Juggernaut); past L30
a finale cycles the six district finale bosses (L35 Spitter Queen, L40 Juggernaut, L45 Colossus, L50 Prime, L55 Twins, L60
Prime, L65 Queen …) and every other level loops L21–L29's bosses. Update the archetype table: "Hulk Twins (L16, L25, L29)".
